definition: people from one area who do things together
description: In a garden between two apartment blocks, an elderly man, a young woman and a small boy kneel at a raised wooden bed and press a seedling into the dark soil. A striped watering can is passed from hand to hand among the neighbours standing around, adults of different ages plus the little boy. The young woman waters the seedlings, the water streaming from the spout onto the soil. She then holds a hand-painted COMMUNITY GARDEN sign over her head, and the whole group of residents cheers and throws their arms up around her.

en.question: What is the blonde woman doing?

de.answer: Sie gießt die Setzlinge im Gemeinschaftsgarten.
de.question: Was macht die blonde Frau?

es.answer: Está regando los plantones en el huerto comunitario.
